beats.title: Opening pressure in the central battle
beats.summary: The party is deep in combat as Stafl chooses Sleep on the Cultist Leader, while Elite Guards and meatlings punish the party and Baergrom is badly hit.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:18-19
anchor_quotes: The group finds themselves deep into the battle.
Stafl decides the best action is to cast Sleep on the Cultist Leader.
Both Elite Guards attack members of the party.
The other Elite Guard attacks the prone Baergrom for a critical hit.

beats.title: Area damage wipes out leaders and meatlings
beats.summary: Ephanna drops Fireball in the center, killing the Cultist Leaders and incinerating meatlings, while the team pushes back the surviving guard and meat pile.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:21-21
anchor_quotes: Ephanna sees another perfect opportunity for Fireball
The Cultist Leaders perish, the meatlings are incinerated
the enormous Meat Pile in the center is now on fire.
Zora, the mage, casts Magic Missile on each of the remaining meatlings and the remaining Elite Guard

beats.title: The meat pile becomes reactive and dangerous
beats.summary: The room’s tendrils surge energy into the Meat Pile, undoing damage and pulling Zora toward the wall, while the Wolf’s head appears from inside it and more meatlings spill out.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:23-23
anchor_quotes: The room quakes, the tendrils squirm, and then begin to swell with energy.
The energy is passed down to the Meat Pile.
Stalf rushes to Zora to help pull back from the tendrils, but they continue to pull her towards the wall.
Then a voice coming from the Meat Pile, the disgusting head of the Wolf appears begging for someone to release him

beats.title: Tunnel reinforcements, rescue attempts, and a new support item
beats.summary: Cultists attack from the tunnel and Stafl is stabbed, but Karsemine frees Zora from the tendrils, and Stafl’s Peacemaker Fiddle lets him kill the remaining guard and wound the cultists.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:25-25
anchor_quotes: Stafl is stabbed in the back by a group of Cultists that have made their way down the tunnel.
Karsemine rushes to her rescue and slices through the tendrils.
Stafl decides to use his brand new item: the Peacemaker Fiddle.
Casting Song of Shattering kills the remaining Elite Guard and injures all of the Cultists.

beats.title: The party stabilizes the platform and breaks another tendril
beats.summary: The group counterattacks: Ephanna shatters a large tendril, Baergrom grants temporary health, Idris presses the attack, and Zora severs the tendril with Magic Missile.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:27-27
anchor_quotes: The group seizes the chance to push back the enemy.
Ephanna casts Shatter on the large tendril and kills several meatlings.
Baergrom moves to the center of the platform and uses his new item
Zora follows up the attack with Magic Missile, severing the tendril in a spray of goo.

beats.title: More cultists and meat flies arrive as the pile keeps pulsing
beats.summary: Another pulse feeds the Meat Pile, spawning meat flies; Bonogo and Caelynn clear cultists while Karsemine focuses on the tendrils as the room escalates again.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:29-29
anchor_quotes: Again the ground shakes and pulses flow down the tendrils to the Meat Pile in the center.
Again the meat swells and spawns a group of Meat Flies.
Caelynn casts Thunderwave on the group of Cultists, killing them all.
Karsemine rushes over to another large tendril and uses both swords to deal major damage.

beats.title: Sleep slows the incoming wave but the meat flies retaliate
beats.summary: Fresh cultists are put to Sleep before they advance, but the remaining meat flies swarm Bonogo, who mostly avoids the damage and receives more shielding from Baergrom.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:31-31
anchor_quotes: More Cultists arrive from another tunnel, but don’t get very far into the room before Stafl casts Sleep.
the remaining meat flies all attack at once against him.
Baergrom uses his shield’s ability, providing temporary healing for the team again.

beats.title: Broken grate and central platform become a hazard
beats.summary: The party keeps damaging the tendril, but Idris falls through a broken grate, a Cultist Guard leaps to the central platform, and the meat creature keeps attacking as Bonogo takes heavy hits.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:33-33
anchor_quotes: Ephanna uses Eldritch Blast and Zora casts Magic Missile on the tendril, combining for some good damage.
Idris moves around the center platform to make an attack, but takes a step on the broken grate and falls through, barely hanging on.
One of the Cultist Guards makes an incredible leap across to the central platform, preparing to attack.
The Cultist Guard hits Bonogo with two attacks dealing a significant amount of damage.

beats.title: Sleeping cultists are culled and the meat pile is hammered
beats.summary: Caelynn and Karsemine finish off the sleeping cultists, Baergrom empowers Bonogo to strike the meat pile hard, and Idris gets back up while Zora continues pressing the tendril.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-16:e8b8399abc94:span:e8b8399abc94:35-35
anchor_quotes: Caelynn casts Snowball on the sleeping Cultist group, killing 2 of them instantly.
Karsemine then leaps to the remaining Cultists and uses Horde Breaker to kill a few more.
Baergrom lifts up his shield and then uses Commander’s Strike to have Bonogo deal massive damage to the meat pile.
Idris is able to climb back up while Zora again casts Magic Missile on the tendril for more damage.

beats.title: Final transformation threatens the ceiling and the city above
beats.summary: The meat pile spawns a centipede-like appendage climbing toward the ceiling, the remaining meat flies complete a transformation into a meat mound, and the party struggles to stop it as the city above is endangered.
